Summary: Show front matter as a quiet document head

Description: Skills, rules and plans lead with YAML or TOML front matter and Marxy renders it as nothing. Draft P08, P12.

Summary: Tell the reader what the renderer removed
Description: Comments, unknown tags and orphan definitions vanish and only console.info knows. Extends MARXY-44's notice. Draft P01.
Acceptance: 1. apps/desktop/test/trust.test.mjs asserts a document with a comment and an unknown tag shows one notice naming both kinds with counts; 2. the notice's list jumps to each removed range in Source, asserted in trust.test.mjs; 3. gate:no-network unchanged and green; 4. scripts/check-registry.mjs green.

Summary: Keep the content of XML-style tags in instruction files
Description: An <instructions> block is deleted with its contents. Needs draft P01 accepted; the path is CODEOWNERS-gated.
Acceptance: 1. vectors.test.ts asserts an unknown element in an instruction-class file keeps its children and records its name as a label, and a script or style element is still removed with its contents; 2. gate:golden regenerated with a prompt-file fixture; 3. gate:no-network green; 4. the probe case prompt-xml-block in lab/probe.mjs reports its text visible.

Summary: Tint added and deleted lines in diff fences, marker first

Summary: Copy code, kbd and commands exactly
Description: --frozen-lockfile pastes with an en dash, kbd is smartened, and a one-line command copies with a trailing newline. Draft P06.
Acceptance: 1. typography.test.ts asserts no substitution inside code, kbd or samp, including when opened by raw HTML; 2. operations.test.ts asserts a block copy ends with one newline only if the source did and a one-line command copies with none; 3. gate:fidelity unchanged and green.

Summary: Close the reserved-id and clobbering bypass
Description: An island can keep id=marxy-fn-1 through the whole pipeline, and ids such as cookie survive. Draft P02. CODEOWNERS-gated.
Acceptance: 1. vectors.test.ts has a vector each for a marxy- id, a marxy- class and a global-shadowing id, with and without the public provenance attribute, each shown failing before the fix; 2. gate:golden regenerated and gate:no-network green on the hostile fixture; 3. the ADR-0023 amendment is in the PR and check:registry is green.

Summary: Stop copy-section rewriting text in clipboard HTML
Description: Two regexes over rendered HTML delete text that looks like an attribute, so `a data-marxy-k="9" b` copies as `a b`.
Acceptance: 1. operations.test.ts asserts the clipboard html of a section holding that inline code and an html fence keeps their text byte for byte; 2. the two regular expressions are gone from copy-section.ts, asserted by operations.test.ts reading the file; 3. gate:fidelity green.

Summary: Recognise GitHub alerts with a label-first head
Paths: packages/core/src/render, packages/theme/src/base.css, scripts/registry.json, fixtures/corpus, packages/core/goldens, docs/taste-review/queue.md

Summary: Every task item keeps its checkbox

Summary: Hold every colour pair with a check that can fail
Description: The gate samples the first p, a caption class nothing emits, and the first code. Draft P14.
Acceptance: 1. gate:aesthetics fails a fixture in which a link, a kbd or a table head is below 4.5:1, shown by --selftest; 2. the gate:aesthetics contrast pass covers every text-on-tint pair and every fixtures/themes theme; 3. docs/aesthetics-acceptance.md matches what the gate runs, asserted by a check:docs test.

Summary: Forced colours, contrast preference and reduced motion
Description: No stylesheet has forced-colors, prefers-contrast or prefers-reduced-motion; the diff and alert markers depend on them. Draft P14.
Acceptance: 1. gate:aesthetics renders the diff and alert fixtures under forced-colors: active and asserts the marker and word survive; 2. gate:aesthetics runs at 320 px and asserts no page-level horizontal scroll; 3. packages/theme/test/media-queries.test.mjs asserts base.css contains the three media queries.

Summary: Honour <details> and make it a grid unit
Description: details is transparent and always open; under the wide policy a blank-line body renders outside it. Draft P03.
Acceptance: 1. policy.test.ts asserts details and summary survive with open: boolean, and script inside remains stripped; 2. pipeline.test.ts asserts the blank-line body sits inside its details; 3. gate:aesthetics grid check passes with a closed and an open details; 4. Find opens closed ancestors, asserted in apps/desktop/test/details.test.mjs.

Summary: Highlight console sessions and show ESC
Description: $ is coloured as a function; there is no console grammar and ESC is invisible. Draft P13.
Acceptance: 1. highlight.test.ts asserts a console fence classes $ as punctuation and leaves output unclassed; 2. gate:licences green with shellsession and jsonl recorded; 3. apps/desktop/test/ansi.test.mjs asserts ESC renders as a visible glyph in Rendered mode and copy yields the byte; 4. apps/desktop/test/source-special-chars.test.mjs asserts highlightSpecialChars is installed.

Summary: Line numbers in Source mode, kept out of copies
Description: Source passes lineNumbers false. The measurement that numbers stay out of copies used a harness, not the app.
Acceptance: 1. apps/desktop/test/source-gutter.test.mjs asserts a non-markdown file opens with numbers and a copy across lines contains none, in the shipped app's webview; 2. a toggle in the palette turns them off, asserted in source-gutter.test.mjs; 3. gate:aesthetics chrome-at-rest check still green in Rendered mode.

Summary: Extend the operation fidelity property, and validate splice
Description: MARXY-43 added a mutation property over task markers and tables in .md corpus files. Still open: non-markdown corpus files and other node kinds are skipped, splice validates nothing, and bare-CR files report eol none.

Summary: Make section ranges and nodeAt nesting-aware

Acceptance: 1. sourcemap.test.ts asserts a nested heading's range ends at its container's end and copySection refuses a range that is not its section; 2. nodeAt reaches a taskMarker by byte, asserted in sourcemap.test.ts; 3. gate:golden green.
